title: Event Registration Sign-In Log
subtitle: Capture event admission, ticket class, session choice, and accommodation; confirm payment reference and check-in status.
description: Event Registration records event admission, ticket class, session choice, accommodation, payment reference, and check-in status. Event Registration evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this event registration attendance and custody reconciliation when staff must document event admission and ticket class. Reconcile session choice, accommodation, payment reference, and check-in status before the event registration handoff. Use the registration record, ticket or admission selection, payment receipt reference, session inventory, accommodation acknowledgment, confirmation message, and check-in scan. This record establishes attendee admission through ticket type, session inventory, purchaser contact, confirmation barcode, accommodation routing, payment reference, and check-in eligibility. It may also distinguish access tiers, guest passes, promotional codes, refund status, transferability, QR delivery, door-list lookup, and badge-printing readiness. Ask the assigned event registration reviewer to confirm event admission against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Event Registration details

sections.guidance: Reconcile expected, checked-in, departed, and unresolved roster entries.
